part.text: Target db is `european_football_2`. Let me lock the db and get mapping for Player and Player_Attributes.
Mappings obtained. Player has `height`, `player_name`; Player_Attributes has `heading_accuracy`. Now compute per-player average heading accuracy (SUM/COUNT per player) filtered by height > 180.

input.sql:
SELECT p.player_name AS name,
       SUM(pa.heading_accuracy) / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) AS avg_heading_accuracy
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_fifa_api_id = p.player_fifa_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
GROUP BY p.player_fifa_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY avg_heading_accuracy DESC
LIMIT 10;
